{{Quote|I had to promise to pay a cargo pilot fifty gemstones to bring me here.|[[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba the Hutt]]|<ref name="POTDS" />}}
A '''cargo pilot''' met with [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba the Hutt]] at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] after the latter was marooned on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after running afoul of [[Trioculus]] and his [[Trioculus' Empire|Imperial Remnant Faction]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] agreed to transport Zorba aboard their [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo spaceship]] from Tatooine to [[Scardia Station]] within the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] and was paid handsomely upon successfully [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] there.<ref name="POTDS" />
